displayDescription: Fixed node graph where seeded particle streams carry an idea from INTAKE through EXCHANGE to OUTCOME, pulsing once on each arrival.
audioDescription: Silent preview; no music, sound effects or voice.
limitations: Halos are flat SVG radial gradients standing in for glow, not a lighting simulation.
Particles are seeded procedural dots sampled on authored Bezier curves, not a physics simulation.
Node states, LINKS counter and labels are authored illustrative values, not measured data.
Typography uses locally installed Menlo/SF Mono with monospace fallback.
